newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil police seize cocaine, arrest 11.
newsitem.headline: Brazil police seize cocaine, arrest 11.

text.p: Brazilian police on Wednesday seized 491 pounds (223 kg) of Bolivian cocaine and arrested 11 people trying to bring the drugs into Brasilia, police said.
"This is a large quantity that represents a big worry for us," said Paulo Magalhaes, a federal police superintendent in the Brazilian capital.

Police arrested eight people in Brasilia airport as they arrived with the cocaine in suitcases on two flights from the city of Porto Velho, capital of the border state of Rondonia. Three more people were arrested in the airport.
